english.title: Fail to give effect to an interception warrant - RIPA
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being

(A)_[a person who provided a postal service,]_
(B)_[a person who provided a public telecommunication service,]_
(C)_[a person who had control of the whole or part of a telecommunication system located wholly or partly in the United Kingdom, but who did not provide a public telecommunication service]_

and on whom a copy of an interception warrant had been served, knowingly failed to comply with your duty to take all steps for giving effect to the warrant as were notified to you by or on behalf of the person to whom the warrant was addressed, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(4) and (7) of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 11(5) of the Act provides that a person who is under a duty to take steps for giving effect to an interception warrant shall not be required to take any steps which it is not reasonably practicable for them to take.
(ii) A person's duty under the Act to take steps for giving effect to a warrant shall be enforceable by civil proceedings by the Secretary of State for an injunction, or for specific performance of a statutory duty under Section 45 of the Court of Session Act 1988, or for any other appropriate relief.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
